_comment: library/ is the source of truth inside Apollo. The host trees (.claude, .agents, .codex, apollo-studio/knowledge) are GENERATED from it by tools/project.py — nothing here is read at runtime. This file only records provenance.

provenance.skills: KnowledgeFactory library/skills (52) + the 6 Studio-store skills + 71 personal skills from the user's ~/.claude/skills, folded in Phase 1 of the unification (see git history / PROGRESS.md).
provenance.agents: The 5 specialists were converted from .codex/agents/*.toml; design-director was written new. Apollo_claude's 12 agents were deliberately not ported (decision 4).
provenance.doctrines: The 4 doctrines came from the now-archived Apollo_claude donor.

personal_upstream.note: Still the global Claude load path. Read-only donor; never modified by this system.
